algorithm: Restore each authenticated archive in chronological order. Initial manifest rows map source->stage;2a files map source->stage. Later logical_files carry prior mapping or content member under the archive stage directory. Preserve all source+sha256 versions; same-byte aliases share payload. Final archive capture-manifest includes every current source mapping and explicit exclusions.
private_config: Encrypted only. Existing independently delivered settings are verified in managed-recovery-proof.json; no individual secret values or hashes are published.
native: manifest.json describes frozen captured versions, not future raw files.
